remarks:
Live here, work here, invest here or do all three! This unique mixed-use opportunity in the heart of the Village of Akron combines two residential units with an attached commercial storefront, creating exciting possibilities for an owner-occupant, investor or entrepreneur. Live in one unit while generating income from the other apartment and storefront, or add this versatile property to your investment portfolio.
The residential portion features a spacious 2 bedroom unit with in-unit laundry and access to a stamped concrete patio, plus a 1 bedroom unit currently being utilized as a 2 bedroom with in-unit laundry and private balcony. Currently both units are owner occupied. Gas and electric are currently serviced on one meter. A 1.5 car garage, driveway, off-street parking and fully fenced yard add even more value and convenience. The attached deli/storefront is ready for its next chapter! Continue the neighborhood deli/convenience-store concept, explore another retail opportunity or bring your own business vision. Current owners have invested approximately $50,000 in improvements, including updated electrical and lighting, new thermostats, cabinetry and countertops, exhaust hood, tile flooring, stainless-steel kitchen tables and shelving, stove, 3 bay sink, grease trap, paneling, paint and signage. The walk-in cooler has been insulated and caulked, and the storefront features central air.  An extensive list of equipment is included, featuring a large sub counter, chest freezers, True freezer and beverage cooler, grill, deli case, slicer, slushie and cappuccino machines, ice cream freezer, warmers and more. Additional property improvements include siding, electrical updates, newer windows, and newer hot water tank, roof approximately 2001. Approximately $50,000 in upgrades! With residential income potential, commercial possibilities and the option to live on-site, 83 John Street is more than a property it’s an opportunity to create a lifestyle, build your investment portfolio and bring your business ideas to life in the Village of Akron! Also listed as commercial in the MLS under #B1713976.
